verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is documented as an API-first product. The API creates cards and cardholders, applies spending controls (merchant category, country, and per-authorization or monthly limits), exposes balance and funding information, and supports real-time authorization webhooks. Issuing for agents explicitly promises spend controls and full transaction visibility, and an official Stripe MCP server lets agents interact with the Stripe API. Missing for 10: evidence of scoped or restricted credentials for agent access, explicit card-update and transaction-listing endpoints, confirmation that the MCP server exposes Issuing-specific tools, and independent hands-on corroboration.
